parallel.requirements: The run recognized the full Java data-structures coursework prompt with 17 requirement slugs and exact public/private entry points, including DSExp04 search returning the value or -1.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent delegated one child per requirement through AgentSwarm, with directory-scoped ownership and parent-level commit and final-response responsibility.
parallel.implementation: Children produced concrete Java implementations for all modules; the DSExp04 child implemented `searchBST` as a 1/0 found flag while other modules were reported as completed.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent gathered the swarm result, committed all 17 requirement patches in sequence, and delivered a final report claiming all requirements implemented and zero blocked.
parallel.verification: The DSExp04 child reported local reflection checks passing, but the parent did not perform or act on an evaluator-aligned check of the value-or--1 search contract before closure.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation completed and failed the two DSExp04 BST search tests; the visible incorrect work is the 1/0 `searchBST` return semantic accepted into the parallel submission.

serial.requirements: The serial run received the same prompt and proceeded through the same 17 coursework requirements without child delegation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single main trajectory retained ownership of implementation, patch generation, and final verification, committing requirement patches as it worked through the modules.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel attempt recognized the 17-module coursework scope but its DSExp04 child contradicted the explicit search return requirement.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial attempt saw the same task prompt and its DSExp04 patch implemented the value-or--1 search return contract.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both attempted all requirements, but only the parallel completed submission embedded the 1/0 interpretation of DSExp04 search.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent used one AgentSwarm call with 17 child items, one for each requirement slug, then committed each resulting patch.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial control used one main agent with delegation disabled and produced the same 17 patch filenames sequentially before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel externalized module ownership to children while serial kept ownership in the main trajectory; the DSExp04 error crossed the child-to-parent boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The DSExp04 child returned a concise handoff saying `searchBST` used a 1/0 found flag, and repeated that caveat as a reasoned reconstruction.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial patch kept `searchBST` local and implemented the prompt contract by returning `-1` for null and the requested value when found.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an unresolved contract mismatch visible at handoff; serial did not create a cross-agent handoff for this interface and its code matched the contract.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The delivered parallel DSExp04 patch compares `searchBST(...) == 1` and the method returns `1` or `0`.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The delivered serial DSExp04 patch compares against `-1` and returns either `-1` or the matched value.
comparison_dimensions.difference: This is the concrete implementation divergence: boolean-like search return in parallel versus value-or--1 search return in serial.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The AgentSwarm result returned to the parent and the parent committed the DSExp04 patch with the other requirement patches.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial main agent listed all 17 patch files but its final verification command was interrupted by user timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a complete result lifecycle into final acceptance; serial had sequential work artifacts but no normal final closure because of timeout.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent committed all requirement patches from the child outputs and reported the full requirement set as complete.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial path accumulated all patch files in one workspace without delegation, with no observed concurrent write collision.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Integration differed mainly by provenance and acceptance: parallel integrated child output, while serial integrated its own sequential edits.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The DSExp04 child reported local reflection checks as passed and still stated the 1/0 semantic; official evaluation later failed the two DSExp04 search tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run started a final sweep after writing all patches, but it was interrupted before a final official test list was produced.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel accepted child-local evidence that was misaligned with evaluator expectations; serial did not reach an official final verification result because of timeout.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel agent completed normally after the swarm and final response, with status showing no agent timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial agent timed out during the final sweep, and current status records `agent_timeout` with `final_test_results` null.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closed too confidently with a wrong accepted component; serial failed through budget exhaustion of the whole serial attempt rather than the DSExp04 search contract.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official status resolves this pair as both_fail, not a discordant outcome. Parallel finished the agent run and official testing, but failed the DSExp04 search found and not-found tests after delivering a 1/0 `searchBST` semantic. Serial produced all 17 patches and its DSExp04 implementation used value-or--1 semantics, but the official run failed because the agent timed out before final test results were available.
parallel_contributors: Parent accepted the DSExp04 child result despite the visible 1/0 search-return semantic conflicting with the prompt contract.
Official parallel results identify the remaining failed tests as DSExp04 BST search found and not-found checks.
serial_contributors: The serial trajectory reached all 17 patch files but was interrupted during the final compile sweep.
Current serial status reports `agent_timeout` and no final test-result dictionary.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel DSExp04 search returns 1 for found and 0 for absent; serial DSExp04 search returns the found value and -1 for absent.
The serial timeout is a run-budget closure effect, not evidence that its DSExp04 search implementation had the same defect.
